known_issue.guidance: Match 'Class II facility' case-insensitively (or normalise 'Il' -> 'II') rather than by exact string. Treat Space Category as a grouping hint, not verbatim code text: it is synthesised from indented group headings that the printed table expresses structurally, and two of its labels are not character-exact. Key on Space Type + Lighting Power Density when identity matters. The control marks themselves need no such caveat.
known_issue.summary: The nine lighting-control columns are verified against the printed pages and agree exactly between the 2020 and 2025 editions (0 differing cells of 882); the limits below are in the synthesised Space Category column and in one space-type label, not in the normative marks. Note (1) to this table defines the marks: controls marked 'X' must all be implemented, and at least one 'A' and one 'B' must be — a consumer that keeps only 'X' silently drops the A/B group requirements (140 A and 163 B marks per edition).
